Data Analyzer

Data analysis module for invoice data comparison and statistics.

class src.analyzer.DataAnalyzer(df)

Bases: object

Analyzes invoice data with focus on month-to-month comparisons.

This class provides methods to analyze invoice data, calculate statistics, and compare data across different time periods (months).

Parameters:

df (DataFrame)

df

DataFrame containing the invoice data.

classmethod from_file(file_path, chunksize=None)

Create DataAnalyzer from a data file.

Parameters:

  • file_path (str) – Path to the data file.

  • chunksize (int | None) – If provided, data is processed in chunks and aggregated.

Returns:

DataAnalyzer instance with loaded data.

extract_month(factura_column='FACTURA')

Extract month information from invoice numbers.

Assumes invoice format: MANDT-TIPDOC-NUMERO where TIPDOC indicates month. Example: 001-012-057647312 -> month 012

Parameters:

factura_column (str) – Name of the invoice column. Defaults to ‘FACTURA’.

Return type:

DataFrame

Returns:

DataFrame with original data plus ‘MONTH’ column.

get_summary_stats(value_column='PRECIO_TOTAL')

Calculate summary statistics for invoice amounts.

Parameters:

value_column (str) – Column to calculate statistics on. Defaults to ‘PRECIO_TOTAL’.

Return type:

dict

Returns:

Dictionary with summary statistics.

Raises:

ValueError – If value_column not found in DataFrame.

group_by_column(group_column, value_column='PRECIO_TOTAL', aggregation='sum')

Group data by a column and aggregate values.

Parameters:

  • group_column (str) – Column to group by (e.g., ‘RUBRO’).

  • value_column (str) – Column to aggregate. Defaults to ‘PRECIO_TOTAL’.

  • aggregation (str) – Type of aggregation (‘sum’, ‘mean’, ‘count’, ‘min’, ‘max’). Defaults to ‘sum’.

Return type:

DataFrame

Returns:

DataFrame with grouped results.

Raises:

ValueError – If columns don’t exist or aggregation is invalid.

compare_periods(period_column, period1, period2, value_column='PRECIO_TOTAL')

Compare values between two periods.

Parameters:

  • period_column (str) – Column containing period identifiers.

  • period1 (str) – First period to compare.

  • period2 (str) – Second period to compare.

  • value_column (str) – Column with values to compare.

Returns:

  • period1_total, period2_total: Totals for each period

  • difference: Absolute difference

  • percentage_change: Percentage change from period1 to period2

Return type:

dict

Raises:

ValueError – If periods or columns don’t exist.

top_by_value(group_column, value_column='PRECIO_TOTAL', n=10)

Get top N groups by value.

Parameters:

  • group_column (str) – Column to group by.

  • value_column (str) – Column with values to sort by.

  • n (int) – Number of top results. Defaults to 10.

Return type:

DataFrame

Returns:

DataFrame with top N groups sorted by value descending.

Raises:

ValueError – If columns don’t exist or n is invalid.

get_row_count()

Get total number of rows in the data.

Return type:

int

Returns:

Number of data rows.

get_columns()

Get list of all column names.

Return type:

list[str]

Returns:

List of column names in the DataFrame.
